description: Search new and used cars for sale at local dealers, in plain language. Every car comes back with its advertised price, its market price, how far under or over market it is, a deal label, a 0 to 100 score and its rank among comparable cars. Use a market name in the query or the market argument. Returns up to 10 cars per call, best deals first.

market.description: Market slug from list_markets, for example 'dallas-tx'. Optional if the query names the city.

query.description: What the shopper wants, in their words. Examples: 'used SUV under $30k AWD', 'new Honda CR-V', 'certified Toyota under 40,000 miles', 'something cheap on gas for commuting'.

name: search_cars
title: Search cars for sale
